name: Four Seasons Hotel Doha
positioning: Beachfront luxury hotel on The Corniche in Doha's West Bay, opened in 2005
best_for: Travelers who want a beachfront base in West Bay
Families wanting a supervised children's programme

facts.text: The hotel has 237 rooms in total.
The hotel is the centrepiece of the West Bay business and residential complex on Doha's waterfront.
The hotel is located on a private sand beach.
The hotel is only 7 minutes from downtown.
Hamad International Airport is 40 minutes by car from the hotel.
The interiors were designed by Pierre-Yves Rochon.
Kids for All Seasons is a supervised children's programme in a dedicated facility.
Nobu Doha serves Chef Nobuyuki Matsuhisa's new-style Japanese cuisine.
Curiosa by Jean-Georges serves Latin-inspired cuisine.

highlights.text: Nobu Doha is dramatically perched above the Arabian Gulf.
Seasons Tea Lounge has an atrium-style winter garden.
Premier Sea-View Rooms have a view of the Arabian Gulf, and most include a step-out balcony.
Makani Beach Club is a seafront beach club for outdoor meals and sundowners.
The spa has a Private Spa Suite with twin treatment beds.

considerations.text: Condé Nast Traveler says the city sits directly beneath the airport's flight path, with a constant barrage of airplanes passing overhead.
Condé Nast Traveler says reservations are a must at Nobu.
Condé Nast Traveler says almost all rooms have views of the sea, even if at an angle or through the glittering skyscrapers.
WhataHotel notes limited walkable attractions in the immediate vicinity.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
